why.p1: The K5 rotor turns slowly and almost silently, shrugs off gusts and shifting wind direction, and needs no tail vane or yawing.
why.p2: Gearless generator, ballast braking, IP54 enclosure: one service a year, from the ladder on the mast.
why.alt: K5 wind turbine on its mast

contact.p: Write or call: we'll size the wind, the mast and the kit for your site.

story.title: From raw stock to wind.
story.lead: We build the K5 vertical-axis wind turbine ourselves, from winding the stator to installing it on your site. Scroll and watch how.
story.svgLabel: How the K5 wind turbine is manufactured, assembled and installed

s1.h: The heart of K5 is a permanent-magnet generator.
s1.p: Electrical-steel stator, copper winding, 72 neodymium magnets. No gearbox, nothing to wear out.

s2.h: Three composite blades, layer by layer.
s2.p: Glass fabric from 48 to 400 g/m², epoxy, foam spar. Laid up in the mould layer by layer, cured, painted, balanced.

s3.h: Assembled and turned for the first time.
s3.p: Ø170 shaft, struts, blades onto the generator. The rotor has to start from 1.5 m/s.

s4.p: Rebar cage, concrete, anchor plate. A 12, 18 or 24 m mast bolts together at flanges, with a service ladder.

s5.h: The rotor seats on the mast. The cable goes indoors.
s5.p: MPPT controller, ballast load, batteries. From here on, only the wind works.
